description: This file defines an interface PolicyAdapter for policy adapters within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides default implementations for methods related to topic groups and channels, specifically in the context of handling signals.

classes.name: PolicyAdapter
classes.description: A generic interface for policy adapters that extend the Signal interface. Provides default topic group and channel set implementations.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns a set containing the POLICIES group, indicating the policy-related topic group for this adapter.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns a set containing NONE channel, indicating no specific channels in use.
